abstract: The clinical value of serum ferritin level in patients with testicular cancer was studied. Seven cases of seminoma and nine cases of non-seminoma from 1983 to 1989 were evaluated. The serum levels of ferritin, human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-HCG), alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) and lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) were estimated before and after treatment. Abnormally high values of serum ferritin before treatment were noted in 4/7 (57%) in seminoma, 3/9 (33%) in non-seminoma and 7/16 (44%) in total. The total rate showing abnormally high values of serum ferritin was lower than that of beta-HCG and LDH. Meanwhile it was the same as that of AFP and higher than that of CEA. Changes in the serum ferritin level did not always correspond with the clinical course. In 3 out of 6 tumor free patients, higher levels of serum ferritin before treatment became normal after treatment. In one patient with a high level of serum ferritin before treatment, the level of serum ferritin remained higher and retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis developed after treatment. In 9 cases with normal serum ferritin level, 7 showed the normal range of ferritin level throughout the treatment course. These findings suggests that in some patients with testicular cancer, the serum ferritin level might serve as a tumor marker indicating the efficacy of the treatment and the tumor recurrence.
abstract_ja: 精巣がん患者における血清フェリチン値の臨床的意義を検討した。1983年から1989年までに、セミノーマ7例と非セミノーマ性腫瘍9例を評価した。治療の前後に、フェリチン、β-hCG、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、CEA、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)の血清値を測定した。治療前のフェリチン異常高値は、セミノーマで4/7(57%)、非セミノーマ性腫瘍で3/9(33%)、全体では7/16(44%)に認められた。フェリチン異常高値の割合は、β-hCGやLDHより低かった。一方、AFPとは同程度で、CEAよりは高かった。血清フェリチン値の変化は必ずしも臨床経過と一致しなかった。腫瘍の消失した6例中3例では、治療前の高値が治療後に正常化した。治療前の血清フェリチン値が高かった1例では、高値が持続し、治療後に後腹膜リンパ節転移が生じた。血清フェリチン値が正常であった9例のうち7例は、治療経過を通じて正常範囲内であった。これらの所見から、一部の精巣がん患者では、血清フェリチン値が治療効果や再発を示す腫瘍マーカーとなりうると考えられる。
